question: Interpret for me the current trend in positive affect of the world from 2008 to 2022?

We are grouping by years, ordering them in ascending order (to see trends over time), limiting results so as not to exceed a certain number of rows per your instruction ("Limit query results to 50 rows only"), although the limit would be adjusted if we want more data points for each year across countries. If '50 rows' means 5 years per year limit due to other columns not being used for this question's context, then it's interpreted as every fifth year's average positive affect from each country. If it refers strictly to a maximum number across all results irrespective of the time range (which seems less likely given your instructions), we'd need further clarification on how many total rows are desired and whether that's per year or globally.
